ImagePad 1.2.0 is out 🎉

Need to change a photo before uploading it, but a big editor is overkill? ImagePad opens beside the page you are on. Crop to a site frame, blur a face, add a watermark, then drag it straight into the site. Nothing leaves your device.

Chrome, Edge and Firefox. Store links: coming soon.
